Overview quest for the Asuran arc.

==Objectives==
*Complete the "[[Zinn's Task]]" or "[[The Knowledgeable Asura]]" quest
*Speak with the Asura [[Chark]] in the [[Tarnished Coast]].
*Witness the events of [[Trial of Zinn|Zinn's "trial."]]
*Report to [[Salma]] in Talmark Wilderness on the outcome of the Asuran Trial.
*Speak with the [[Lion's Arch Keep Gate Guard|Lion's Arch Keep gate guard]] to gain access to [[Lion's Arch Keep]] where Salma will have your congratulatory message.

==Walkthrough==
After completing either Zinn's Task or the Knowledgeable Asura quests, map travel to [[Vlox's Falls]] and exit into [[Arbor Bay]]. Talk to [[Chark]] who is immediately outside the portal you just came through. Simply entering Zinn's Trial and stepping into the witness area will complete the objective for witnessing the trial, it is not necessary to watch the entire scene.

After that, return to the Shining Blade camp to witness [[War in Kryta dialogues#Dialogue 4 - Livia Recruits Zinn|Livia Recruits Zinn]]. Once the dialogue is complete, then head to the [[Lion's Arch Keep]] and talk to Salma to finish the quest.

==Notes==
*This quest was added on [[Feedback:Game updates/20101118|November 18, 2010]].
**Before the [[Feedback:Game updates/20101119|November 19, 2010]] update, this quest was automatically placed in your quest log after witnessing [[War in Kryta dialogues#Dialogue 2 - Search for Allies|Search for Allies]] if [[The War in Kryta]] was active.
* After reporting, Livia, Zinn and Blimm will walk towards the future site of the [[Secret River Passage]], which will appear the next time the player enters this map.

==Trivia==
*One of the few quests that has no reward.
